name: Vanilla Bliss
tagline: Warm vanilla bean, tonka and a drift of coconut cream.
description: The candle you reach for without thinking. Vanilla Bliss opens creamy and soft, settles into a warm bakery sweetness and never turns cloying — a gentle glow for the corners of the day.
story: We built Vanilla Bliss around Madagascan vanilla absolute rather than the usual synthetic vanillin, then rounded it with tonka and a whisper of toasted coconut. The result smells like a kitchen at golden hour.

name: Rose Petal
tagline: Fresh-cut garden roses with a dewy green edge.
description: Not the powdery rose of old drawers — this is the rose you bury your face in. Bright, dewy petals over a soft musk, in a blush glass that glows pink when lit.
story: Rose Petal uses a Bulgarian rose accord layered with lychee for sparkle and a touch of green stem so the flower smells alive, not pressed.

name: Lemongrass
tagline: Crushed lemongrass, green tea and cool mint.
description: A clean, kitchen-garden freshness that clears the room. Lemongrass is our morning candle — zesty and green at first, softening into tea leaves and a faint mint coolness.
story: Steam-distilled lemongrass oil from Kerala meets a sheer green tea accord. We kept the base deliberately light so the scent stays crisp from first light to last.

name: Lavender Fields
tagline: Provence lavender, chamomile and soft linen.
description: The slow exhale at the end of the day. True lavender, rounded with chamomile and a clean linen musk — calming without smelling like a spa.
story: High-altitude lavandin from Provence gives the brightness; a touch of lavender absolute adds the hay-like depth. Light it twenty minutes before bed.

name: Sandalwood
tagline: Creamy Mysore sandalwood with warm amber.
description: Quietly grounding. A milky, meditative sandalwood that settles the room without announcing itself, finished with a soft amber warmth.
story: Sandalwood is the scent of early mornings in South Indian homes. We paired a sustainable Australian sandalwood with a classic Mysore accord for that creamy, almost sacred smoothness.

name: Citrus Zest
tagline: Blood orange, grapefruit and a twist of neroli.
description: Sunshine in a tumbler. Sparkling citrus peel that fills a room in minutes — bright, happy and endlessly re-lightable.
story: Cold-pressed Sicilian blood orange and pink grapefruit sit on a neroli heart, so the freshness lingers instead of fading the way pure citrus does.

name: Amber & Saffron
tagline: Golden saffron threads over molten amber and honey.
description: Our signature. Saffron's leathery warmth meets a resinous amber that glows through the honey-coloured glass. It smells like candlelight looks.
story: Kashmiri saffron is one of the most expensive materials in perfumery. We use a saffron accord built on real safranal, warmed with labdanum and benzoin — the candle that started NOORÉ.

name: Oud & Oak
tagline: Smoky oud, aged oak barrels and dark leather.
description: Deep, dry and a little dangerous. A smoky oud wrapped in charred oak and worn leather, in near-black glass with a brass rim. For libraries, late nights and good whisky.
story: We softened the animalic edge of traditional oud with oak-barrel and whisky-lactone notes, so it reads as refined rather than medicinal — the oud for people who think they don't like oud.

name: Velvet Rose
tagline: Dark Turkish rose, raspberry and patchouli.
description: A rose with its evening dress on. Velvety Turkish rose deepened with raspberry and a shadow of patchouli, glowing through rose-quartz glass.
story: Where Rose Petal is the garden, Velvet Rose is the ballroom. Rose absolute and geranium are darkened with patchouli and a drop of oud for an unmistakably grown-up bloom.

name: White Jasmine
tagline: Night-blooming jasmine, tuberose and soft sandal.
description: Heady and luminous. Indian jasmine sambac at full bloom, lifted with tuberose and anchored in a milky sandalwood, in a speckled stone vessel that feels hand-thrown.
story: Jasmine is harvested before dawn in Tamil Nadu, when the flowers are at their most fragrant. We capture that moment — green, indolic, honeyed — and keep it in bloom for fifty hours.

name: Eucalyptus Mint
tagline: Cool eucalyptus, peppermint and wet cedar.
description: A deep breath of forest air. Crisp eucalyptus and peppermint over rain-soaked cedar in bottle-green glass — the candle for the bathroom you wish was a spa.
story: We balanced the sharpness of eucalyptus globulus with a softer eucalyptus radiata and a mossy cedar base, so it refreshes without smelling clinical.

name: Musk Noir
tagline: Black musk, iris and smoked vanilla.
description: Skin-close and shadowy. A dark, velvety musk softened with powdery iris and a curl of smoked vanilla, in matte black glass. Minimal on the shelf, maximal in the room.
story: Musk Noir was composed to smell like cashmere at midnight — clean musks layered until they turn plush, then darkened with iris and a trace of birch tar.

name: Royal Oud
tagline: Cambodian oud, rose and amber in gold-veined marble.
description: The crown of the collection. A regal oud — smooth, resinous, lightly floral — in a white marble vessel veined with gold and sealed with a brass lid. It changes a room the moment the lid lifts.
story: Royal Oud is built on a Cambodian oud accord with the honeyed, slightly fruity character prized in Gulf perfumery, polished with Taif rose and a long amber base. Thirty-six hours of maceration before every pour.

name: Gulab & Oud
tagline: Indian gulab rose over smoky oud and saffron.
description: A love letter to the Indian wedding. Rich gulab — the rose of garlands and rosewater — meets a smoky oud in a deep garnet vessel trimmed in gold. Lush, nostalgic, unforgettable.
story: Gulab & Oud pairs Rosa damascena from Kannauj, the perfume capital of India, with a smoky Assam oud. It is the scent of mehendi nights and silk saris — our most-gifted luxury candle.

name: Midnight Bloom
tagline: Tuberose, black orchid and incense in black marble.
description: Flowers that open only after dark. Narcotic tuberose and black orchid wrapped in incense smoke, in a black marble vessel shot through with gold. Dramatic, nocturnal, addictive.
story: Composed around a tuberose absolute and a resinous frankincense, Midnight Bloom is what a greenhouse would smell like at midnight if someone lit incense in it.

name: Sacred Sandal
tagline: Temple sandalwood, frankincense and milk.
description: Serene and devotional. True sandalwood as it is used in temples — creamy, resinous, almost sweet — lifted with frankincense and a soft milky accord in white marble with gold veining.
story: Sacred Sandal is poured with a higher proportion of sandalwood oil than anything else we make. It is the candle our founder lights every morning.

name: Tea & Bergamot
tagline: Earl Grey, bergamot and smoky lapsang in malachite.
description: An afternoon in a very good hotel. Bergamot-bright Earl Grey, a wisp of smoky lapsang souchong and a honeyed base, in a malachite-green vessel with a brass lid.
story: We steeped three teas into one accord — Darjeeling for brightness, Earl Grey for the bergamot, lapsang for smoke — then sweetened it with a trace of honey and fig.

name: Orchid Noir
tagline: Black orchid, dark plum and smoked vanilla.
description: Velvet in candle form. A dark, honeyed orchid over plum and smoked vanilla, poured into porcelain white with a black label and brass lid — the most-requested candle in our gifting studio.
story: Orchid Noir balances a sweet, rummy plum against a cool orchid accord and a vanilla smoked over oak chips. It is NOORÉ at its most decadent.

name: The Essentials Trio
tagline: Three Essentials in a ribboned linen box.
description: Vanilla Bliss, Lavender Fields and Citrus Zest — morning, noon and night — nestled in our linen-textured gift box with a satin ribbon and a hand-written card.
story: Our most-loved housewarming gift. Three everyday scents that cover every room and every mood.

name: The Premium Duo
tagline: Amber & Saffron with Oud & Oak, boxed.
description: Our two signature Premium candles — one golden, one dark — in a rigid gift box with brass snuffer. The gift for the person who already has everything.
story: Light them together: the saffron lifts the oud, the oud deepens the amber. A pairing we discovered by accident in the studio and now give to everyone.

name: The Luxury Signature Box
tagline: Royal Oud, Gulab & Oud and Orchid Noir with matches and snuffer.
description: Three Luxury candles in marble and porcelain, a brass wick trimmer and snuffer, and a box of long matches, presented in our black lacquer gifting chest. The ultimate NOORÉ gift.
story: Assembled by hand in our gifting studio, each box is finished with a gold-foiled card and a wax seal. Corporate quantities and engraving available on request.
